metadata.case_name: CHOI SUN HONG v. CHINA HARBOUR ENTERPRISE CONSTRUCTIONS LTD AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_after: Quality control worker at Hung Fook Tong
plaintiff.education_level: Completed Form 3; 1-year vocational course in carpentry; craft certificate in wood trade; Construction Industry Training Authority honour award in coarse and fine wood crafts

injuries.description: neck sprain with soft tissue injury.
source: neck sprain with soft tissue injury.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified strain or sprain of cervical spine

injuries.description: mild contusion injury to the soft tissues of his low back
source: mild contusion injury to the soft tissues of his low back
injuries.icd_description: Contusion of lower back or pelvis

injuries.description: adjustment disorder ("AD") with mixed anxiety and depressed mood
source: adjustment disorder ("AD") with mixed anxiety and depressed mood

injuries.description: degenerative changes to the C3/4, C4/5, C5/6 and L4/5 discs
source: degenerative changes to the C3/4, C4/5, C5/6 and L4/5 discs

manifestations.description: Posterior neck pain radiating down the whole back to the buttocks
Mild limitation in the range of movement of the cervical spine
Reduced sitting tolerance (30 minutes) and walking tolerance (45 minutes)
Pins and needles sensation and/or numbness in bilateral forearms
Right wrist pain on exertion/with cold (pain increased by carrying 5-10lbs)
Transient loss of consciousness for about 10 seconds

PTSD symptoms: nightmares, flashbacks, van/minibus phobia, avoidance of stimuli associated with the Accident, numbing of general responsiveness, impaired sleep and concentration, irritability, palpitations and sweating
Depressive and anxiety symptoms including low mood, insomnia, chest tightness, loss of interest in activities, poor concentration and irritability
Unable to play basketball or badminton (stopped participating in sports and hobbies)
Inability to carry weight of more than 40lbs
Attempted suicide (went to the roof but changed his mind) about 6 months after the Accident

treatments_received: physiotherapy (multiple sessions at TKOH and YCH; about 11 sessions at TKOH; 25 sessions at YCH)
bonesetter treatment (9 times between 15 and 30 March 2005)
Chinese medical clinic treatment (about 30 times per Dr Lau report)
psychiatric treatment and psychiatric medication at WKPC
pain clinic treatment at PMH (Pain Clinic)
clinical psychology / psychotherapy sessions (public sector and clinical psychologist)
treatments_future: periodic psychiatric follow up; psychotherapy (private setting)
analgesics and anti-inflammatory drugs on a need basis

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: No longer played basketball or badminton; stopped sports

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Could do simple housework and cooking but not heavy tasks; needed help bathing in first few days post-discharge
Avoided socialising, loss of desire to socialise and reduced enjoyment of activities
Relationship with mother worsened due to irritability; frequent quarrels with girlfriend led to separation

losses.category: Loss of confidence in going out in the public
losses.description: Fear of riding in minibus (minibus phobia) and avoidance of vans/vehicles on street; would get off minibus mid-journey on one occasion
Unable to return to pre-Accident carpentry "sifu" work which required strenuous physical labour

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Could swim for an hour which provided pain relief but could not resume other sports
post-traumatic stress disorder ("PTSD") adjustment disorder ("AD") with mixed anxiety and depressed mood
